title: Corporate Governance Policy
description: The governance framework, responsibilities, and controls that guide ethical business conduct and regulatory compliance at MoneyCash.
registeredOffice: CREDSOLVE Technologies Private Limited, Flat No. E-2748, Gaur Siddhartham, Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — 201009

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: This Corporate Governance Policy establishes the governance framework for MoneyCash and sets out the principles, responsibilities, and controls necessary to ensure ethical business conduct, regulatory compliance, accountability, transparency, and effective risk management.
MoneyCash is committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance while providing digital lending support services on behalf of regulated lending institutions.
- Strengthen risk management and internal controls.

sections.title: Governance Principles
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall operate in accordance with the following governance principles:
- Conduct all business activities honestly, ethically, and responsibly.
- Provide accurate and timely information to stakeholders and regulatory authorities.
- Ensure that responsibilities and decision-making authority are clearly defined.
- Treat customers, employees, partners, and stakeholders fairly and without discrimination.
- Adhere to all applicable laws, regulations, RBI guidelines, and contractual obligations.
- Place customer interests at the center of business operations.
- Identify, assess, monitor, and manage risks effectively.

sections.title: Relationship with Lending Partners
paragraphs: MoneyCash operates as a Lending Service Provider (LSP) and shall:
- Act within the scope of agreements executed with lending partners.
- Support customer onboarding and servicing activities.
- Follow policies and procedures prescribed by lending partners.
- Comply with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines.
- Cooperate during audits and regulatory reviews.
- Undertake lending activities in its own name.
- Represent itself as a bank or NBFC.
- Make credit decisions unless expressly authorized under applicable regulations.
- All lending decisions remain the sole responsibility of the lending partner.

sections.title: Ethical Business Conduct
paragraphs: MoneyCash is committed to conducting business ethically and professionally.
- Comply with applicable laws and policies.
- Fraudulent, deceptive, or unethical conduct shall not be tolerated.

sections.title: Conflict of Interest
paragraphs: Employees and management shall avoid situations that may create actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest.
- Acceptance of inappropriate gifts or benefits.
- Any conflict of interest must be disclosed promptly to management.
- Appropriate mitigation measures shall be implemented.

sections.title: Customer Protection and Fair Treatment
paragraphs: - Customer interests shall be considered in all business decisions.

sections.title: Regulatory Compliance
paragraphs: - Regulatory compliance shall be monitored on an ongoing basis.

sections.title: Risk Management Framework
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain a risk management framework covering:
- Risks arising from people, processes, systems, and external events.
- Cybersecurity threats and data protection risks.
- Failure to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
- Events that may adversely impact public trust and confidence.
- Risks arising from third-party service providers.
- Customer fraud, identity theft, internal fraud, and financial crime.
- Risk assessments shall be conducted periodically.

paragraphs: MoneyCash shall exercise due diligence before engaging third-party service providers.

paragraphs: - Employees shall comply with all applicable anti-corruption laws.
- Any suspected violation must be reported immediately.

sections.title: Regulatory Disclosure
paragraphs: MoneyCash operates as a Lending Service Provider (LSP) and facilitates digital lending services on behalf of regulated lending institutions, including Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd.
MoneyCash does not independently lend funds, undertake credit underwriting, or make lending decisions.
All loan sanctions, disbursements, underwriting decisions, and regulatory lending obligations remain the responsibility of the lending partner.
